description: The Pakistan Credit Rating Agency Limited (PACRA) is a credit rating agency — the first established in Pakistan — that assesses the creditworthiness of companies and of specific debt instruments and publishes the resulting ratings. It was incorporated in 1994 as a joint venture between the International Finance Corporation, Fitch Ratings and the Lahore Stock Exchange, and its shares trade on the Pakistan Stock Exchange under the symbol GEMPACRA. It is recognised as a national rating agency by the SECP and as an external credit assessment institution by the State Bank of Pakistan.
